topic: Iruka's one sentence in chapter 3, not the Shadow Clones, is what made Naruto
title: Iruka Gave Naruto What The Whole Village Wouldn't
description: Iruka lost his parents to the Nine-Tails and still shielded Naruto from Mizuki in chapter 3. Here's why one sentence mattered more than the Shadow Clones. Do you agree?
comment: Which moment made Naruto who he is: Iruka acknowledging him in chapter 3, or Jiraiya's training later? Pick one.

lines.text: Iruka didn't just save Naruto from Mizuki. He saved him from the whole village.

shot.fallback: teacher shielding a blond boy in a dark forest

lines.text: And I think that one night in chapter 3 is where Naruto's real story starts.

shot.fallback: blond boy and teacher in a night forest

lines.text: Think about what Iruka had lost.

shot.fallback: ninja child watching a giant fox destroy a village

lines.text: His parents were killed when the Nine-Tails attacked, twelve years before the story begins.

shot.fallback: burning village and giant nine-tailed fox

lines.text: So when Mizuki exposes the secret, Iruka has every reason to look at Naruto and see the fox.

shot.fallback: traitor ninja pointing at a shocked blond boy

lines.text: Instead, he takes the shuriken that was meant for Naruto.

shot.fallback: teacher shielding boy from a giant shuriken
teacher with a scar across his nose

lines.text: Iruka is the first person, besides the Third Hokage, to ever acknowledge Naruto.

shot.fallback: teacher smiling at a crying blond boy

lines.text: People say Naruto earned his headband by beating Mizuki with Shadow Clones.

shot.fallback: crowd of blond boy clones surrounding a ninja

lines.text: But the clones only appear after Iruka calls him an excellent student.

shot.search: Naruto Shadow Clones Iruka excellent student
shot.fallback: blond boy surrounded by clones glowing orange

lines.text: One kind sentence did what twelve years of cold stares never could.

shot.fallback: blond boy touching a new forehead protector

lines.text: Naruto didn't prove himself to the village that night. He proved it to one man.

shot.fallback: teacher handing a forehead protector to a boy

lines.text: Because Iruka didn't just save Naruto from Mizuki...

shot.fallback: teacher shielding a blond boy in a dark forest
